title: Stage failure budget
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a rational threshold $	au$ in $(0,1]$, define the stage failure budget as $2A(	au)$ times the nonnegative extended real number obtained by taking the nonnegative part of the real value of the first component of the call-confidence interval at $(n,	au)$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the active cap or call-confidence interval, so their meanings and the value of its first component cannot be specified.
